LiveAgent is cloud help desk software made by Quality Unit. Every customer message, from email, live chat, phone or social media, becomes a ticket in one shared inbox, and AI agents answer customers and hand over to your people. A knowledge base is included. Is LiveAgent good for a small support team? Yes. Most teams start small: one or two people answer email, chat and social media messages from one inbox, and the AI chatbot answers routine questions from your help articles. You pay per agent, so you pay only for the people who answer customers. See the pricing page . How much does LiveAgent cost? LiveAgent is priced per agent per month, with no setup fee, no AI fees and no long-term contract. Plans, prices and the current offer are on the pricing page . Does LiveAgent offer a free trial? Yes. Every plan starts with a 30-day free trial with all features and without a credit card. There is no free plan. Start your free trial . Is LiveAgent legit? Yes. LiveAgent is made by Quality Unit, in business since 2004, with around 100 employees and offices in Bratislava and Wilmington, Delaware. 7,000+ businesses rely on LiveAgent. Its awards include Capterra Best Value 2026, G2 Best Estimated ROI (Summer 2025) and SourceForge Leader (Summer 2026); see all awards and customer stories . Does LiveAgent charge for AI? No. AI features are included in every plan and LiveAgent charges no AI fees. You connect your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or FlowHunt account and pay that provider for what you use. LiveAgent's support team sets it up with you for free. How does the LiveAgent AI chatbot work? The AI chatbot answers website chats from your published help articles. When it cannot answer, or the visitor asks for a person, it hands the chat to your team, and your agents can take over any chat. See the AI chatbot . Which channels does LiveAgent support? Email, live chat, phone through the built-in call center , Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, X, Viber, Telegram and contact forms, all in one shared inbox. A knowledge base is included. See live chat and social media . Can LiveAgent move our data from our current help desk? Yes. LiveAgent's team moves your tickets, contacts and knowledge base from any help desk for free. See how the free migration works . Where is my data stored? In the region you choose when you sign up: the EU, the US or Singapore. Your account's data stays in that region. LiveAgent signs a data processing agreement (DPA) for GDPR with every customer who asks. Read more on GDPR and the DPA and security and privacy . Does LiveAgent work for teams of more than 30 agents? Yes. Larger teams split the work into departments with their own roles, route tickets and chats to the right department, set response-time targets (SLA) and keep an audit log. AI agents answer the repetitive questions, and AI translation lets agents read messages in their own language. Book a demo to plan a rollout with us. When is LiveAgent not the right fit? When you must run the help desk on your own servers (LiveAgent is cloud only), when you need IT asset or change management (LiveAgent is built for support, not for ITIL service management), or when you want a free plan for the long term (LiveAgent has none). Comparing support tools? Start with our guides Hands-on comparisons written by our team, LiveAgent included. Min Chou Â· Kwik Charger, 38 support agents serving customers in 127 countries Â· Read the Kwik Charger story How AI billing works Transparent AI pricing LiveAgent doesn't charge for AI. You connect your own AI provider, such as OpenAI, Anthropic or FlowHunt, and pay it for what you use. Who you pay You pay LiveAgent $0 for AI Just your plan price. No AI fees, no token markup, no per-resolution fees. Every AI feature included Same price however much AI you use + You pay your AI provider Only what you use Billed directly by the provider you choose, at their prices. Switch providers any time. OpenAI Anthropic Google Gemini FlowHunt FlowHunt is our own AI platform, with ready-made templates for your use cases. Whichever AI provider you choose, we set it up for free. What your plan counts AI agents An AI agent is an AI worker with its own instructions, AI model and permissions. It can chat with visitors, reply to tickets and sort them. Your plan sets how many AI agents you can create: Starter 1 , Team 5 , Business 50 , Enterprise unlimited . One AI agent can work in many places, for example the same chatbot on three websites. It still counts once. What AI agents do in LiveAgent Built in, no AI agent needed These run on your AI provider too, but they don't use an AI agent, so they don't count toward your LiveAgent plan. Summaries Call transcripts Translations Frequently asked questions Black Friday How do I get the Black Friday price? Choose a plan and pay by December 15, 2026 with the code for your billing: BLACKFRIDAY40Y takes 40% off annual billing for the first year, BLACKFRIDAY33M takes 33% off monthly billing for the first 12 bills. After that, your plan's regular price applies. It works on every plan, Enterprise included, for new and existing customers. The discount applies to the plan and billing period you pay for with the code. Plans and billing Is there a free trial? Yes. Every plan starts with a 30-day free trial, and no credit card is required. When the trial ends, upgrade to a paid plan to keep your account and everything you set up. Can I change or cancel my plan at any time? Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time, except in the 24 hours before your billing day. If you cancel, your account stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Can my price go up? No. Your plan keeps its regular price for as long as you keep the plan, also when you add agents. A discount you get with a code ends when its period is over. We may change the prices of our plans, but a new price applies only to new customers and to customers who change plan. Moving up within 12 months? Ask us for a special quote . Is there a contract or a setup fee? No setup fees and no long-term commitment: pay monthly and cancel anytime, or pay annually and pay less per agent. Buying through procurement? With an annual plan we provide a written quote and a contract: request a quote . How does LiveAgent's price compare with Zendesk? Our Zendesk pricing guide puts Zendesk's current plans and add-ons next to LiveAgent's. Moving over is free: see Zendesk migration . Can you help me migrate from another help desk? Yes, free on every paid plan: our built-in importers move tickets, contacts and the knowledge base from Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout and other help desks. Large accounts can take several hours or even days to import. How migration works . Which payment methods do you accept? All major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, American Express, Diners), Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, and wire transfer on annual plans. Prices are in USD and exclude VAT. Customers in the EU are invoiced in EUR. VAT is added where it applies: an EU company with a valid VAT ID outside Slovakia pays no VAT (reverse charge) when it enters the VAT ID in its account. What do phone calls cost? LiveAgent charges nothing for calls. Your call center runs on your own phone provider, which bills you directly for phone numbers and minutes. Do you offer a startup discount? Early-stage startups can apply for a special startup deal . How much do I save with annual billing? Up to 21% per agent; how much depends on the plan. Switch between monthly and annual billing above the plans: each card shows your team's monthly total for that billing. How is Enterprise priced? A flat monthly fee that includes 80 agents, about $50 per agent (about $40 on annual billing). Extra agents are $49 / month, or $39 / month on annual billing. What is the difference between Business and Enterprise? Business is billed per agent, for any team size, with higher limits than Team. Enterprise is a flat fee with 80 agents included, the highest limits and a dedicated account manager. AI features How much does AI cost? A typical AI chat costs about $0.11 at your AI provider, so 300 chats a month cost about $33â$81 (at our median and our average); LiveAgent adds nothing on top. $0.11 is the median in LiveAgent's own support in October 2026 ( how we measured it , with the average and our newest chat flow). Drafting replies with AI Answer Assistant costs about $2â3 per 1,000 replies with a low-cost model such as Claude Haiku (our estimate from the providers' list prices, October 2026). The cost depends on the model you choose, the tools an AI agent uses and the length of the chat. Do I need an AI provider account? Yes. AI features run on your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or FlowHunt account, and you pay the provider directly, only for what you use. Your AI provider processes the text under your agreement with it. Does LiveAgent charge for AI? No. No AI fees, no token markup, no per-resolution fees: you pay only your AI provider, for what you use. For AI, plans differ only in the number of AI agents. What if I need more AI agents than my plan includes? You can move to a higher plan. Enterprise includes unlimited AI agents. What is the MCP server on Business and Enterprise? On every plan, your AI agents use LiveAgent's built-in tools. On Business and Enterprise, you can also connect external AI tools, such as Claude, to LiveAgent through its MCP server. Are there any usage limits? Each plan except Enterprise has a limit on the number of AI agents. Where a plan says "unlimited", there is no plan limit, but to keep LiveAgent fast and reliable for everyone, we apply technical and rate limits to AI agents, the API and the MCP server to prevent misuse. Footer LiveAgent is help desk and call center software for small and growing support teams, in business since 2004. Email, live chat, phone, social media and WhatsApp in one shared inbox, with a knowledge base, AI that answers customers and drafts replies, and integrations like Shopify. pages.text: API key My tickets Submit ticket Login API key Home > Technical Support > LiveAgent API > REST API > API key What is an API key API key is an identity of your LiveAgent (like your username and password) which you can use to build your own custom integration solutions. Never give it to anybody you don't trust. If your API key is lost, do not hesitate to generate a new one! Anybody with your API key can fully access your LiveAgent. How can I get my API key While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one. To access the API v1 section click the Settings for API v1 link under the API v3 header. This is how the API v1 section looks where you have settings for your API v1 key. When adding a new API key in v3 you have an option to define permissions for this key (as you can have more keys you can also give different keys to different people with different permissions ). Can I change the API key? Yes both API versions have options to generate new keys and invalidate existing ones. IMPORTANT NOTE: Do not forget that when you generate a new API key for your LiveAgent ALL clients using the old key will stop working immediately ! API v3 use Your API key has to be set in header of your requests: curl --location --request GET 'https://your.ladesk.com/api/v3/tickets' \ --header 'apikey: 0865evv883j6auflvlt7zrwgqn32qo74' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' Here's an example of cURL code in PHP: curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, array('Accept: application/json', ' apikey: 123456_YOUR_API_KEY_123456 ')); Updated: Mar 16, 2021 System outage!
